in_greek.meaning: Λορένζα - feminine form of Λόρης, derived from Λωρής
in_greek.long_meaning: Λορένζα - feminine form of Λόρης, derived from Λωρής, which is a variant of Λωρίς, signifying lord or ruler, in early Christian church associated with the Virgin Mary, emphasizing maternal authority and devotion, spiritual significance in Greek Orthodox tradition

in_latin.name: Lorenza
in_latin.meaning: Lorenza - feminine form of Laurentius, derived from Laurentium
in_latin.long_meaning: Lorenza - feminine form of Laurentius, derived from Laurentium, originally meaning 'laurel tree', associated with Saint Lawrence, symbolizing martyrdom and devotion, significant in early Christian church as a name for women, emphasizing faith and courage, used in various Christian cultures across Europe
